overview: Students from Medford Public Schools shared a series of video testimonials to express gratitude for their teachers and coaches during Teacher and Staff Appreciation Week.

items.title: Elementary and Middle School Student Testimonials
items.summary: Students from early grades and middle school thanked teachers for help with letter sounds, physical education, and creating fun, stress-free classroom environments.

items.title: High School and General Staff Appreciation
items.summary: Older students expressed appreciation for teachers' emotional support, flexibility with after-school help, and dedication to helping them succeed in subjects like chemistry.

subject: Teacher and Staff Appreciation Student Testimonials
